depiction.composition: hand gripping tilted rectangular screen device, front view

readings.meaning: using a phone / screen time / mobile app
NFC tap / contactless payment with phone

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the fingers gripping the side can look like signal waves or a spiral notebook binding.

modifier_semantics.meaning: active use, portability, or mobile interaction

task_intents: set up or configure a smartphone
replace or repair a mobile phone
back up phone photos and data
install or test a mobile app
buy a phone case or protector

Move two-factor authenticators over to the new handset

Get an eSIM for Japan installed and tested before we head to the airport
Turn off background data for all the games draining the battery by noon
Find out if our credit card covers accidental damage on a dropped cell phone

reasoning: Clearly depicts a hand holding a smartphone, making it an obvious match for tasks centered on the phone itself (setup, repair, accessories, mobile plans, apps, screen time). For making phone calls a traditional handset icon is clearer, and at tiny sizes the fingers on the right edge slightly resemble a spiral binding.
